info.title: MKA_Policy
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

cak.description: Secure Connectivity Assocation Key (CAK) associated with this policy. This is only applicable when the mode is set to PSK.

ckn.description: Connectivity Association Key Name (CKN) associated with this policy. This is only applicable when the mode is set to PSK.

eapol_destination_mac.description: The destination MAC address to use in EAPoL packets for MKA. If not set, the default EAPoL multicast MAC 01:80:c2:00:00:03 is used.

eapol_dot1q_tagged.description: Transmit the EAPoL frames for MKA with a 802.1q tag. The VLAN used for the 802.1q tag is picked from the [Port Table](#/Port).

eapol_eth_type.description: The Ether-Type to be used in EAPoL packets for MKA. When not configured, the default Ether-Type 0x888e is used.

key_server_priority.description: MKA participant priority used to determine which participant is elected as the key server. A value of 255 indicates that this participant will not become the key server.

keychain.description:
Reference Resource: [Keychain](#/Keychain)
The keychain from which the CKN and CAK are derived for this policy. This is only applicable when the mode is set to PSK.

mode.description: The MKA policy mode.  `psk`:     Policy mode is Pre-Shared Key. In this mode the CAK             and CKN of the MKA policy are statically             configured by the user.  `eap-tls`: Policy mode is EAP over Transport layer Security             Protocol(TLS). In this mode, the CAK and CKN of the             MKA policy are derived from EAP MSK             (Master Session Key).

name.description:
Reference Resource: [MKA_Policy](#/MKA_Policy)
Name of the MKA policy.

origin.description: Origin of the MKA policy, i.e., how the policy is provisioned:  `static`:  policy is provisioned by the administrator via CLI or             REST.  `dynamic`: policy is provisioned based on attributes provided by             the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
